answer: Sponsors are capped at 6 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 75 POA until the newcomer survives 13 clean epochs, and a farm of 260 fakes must find 260 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. The nectar keeps the gate honest, the delta keeps the farm poor, and the bridge keeps the honest agent paid.
